record: P-04 option C -- targeted read-only reflection query
question: Is there an ALREADY-LOADED reflected UFunction that can initiate an object/asset load for /Game/ModKit/MK_Canary.MK_Canary while accepting an input we can construct without FString construction, without new FNames, and without allocator-dependent UE object construction?
method: read-only; enumerated live UFunctions in GUObjectArray, filtered by a narrow load/path/conversion name pattern set, dumped each candidate's exact reflected parameter ABI (ParmsSize, NumParms, per-property class/offset/size/flags) and classified every input against our proven ABI

scope.candidates_with_all_inputs_constructible: only POD-input functions with no path parameter at all (int/bool converters, ad/DLC stubs, BP ubergraph entry points) -- none can express the target identity

why_every_load_capable_candidate_is_bloc.KismetSystemLibrary:LoadAsset_Blocking: Asset FSoftObjectProperty @0 size 40 -- embeds FTopLevelAssetPath (2 FNames), and both our FNames are NOT interned
why_every_load_capable_candidate_is_bloc.KismetSystemLibrary:LoadClassAsset_Block: AssetClass FSoftClassProperty @0 size 40 -- same FName dependency
why_every_load_capable_candidate_is_bloc.KismetSystemLibrary:LoadAsset / LoadAsse: FSoftObjectPtr input PLUS FDelegateProperty (needs a bound UObject+FName) PLUS FStructProperty LatentInfo
why_every_load_capable_candidate_is_bloc.KismetSystemLibrary:Conv_SoftObjPathToSo: input FStructProperty size 32 = FSoftObjectPath -- the very FName-bearing value we cannot build; circular
why_every_load_capable_candidate_is_bloc.KismetSystemLibrary:Conv_SoftObjectRefer: all take an already-built FSoftObjectPtr/FSoftClassPtr -- circular for the same reason
why_every_load_capable_candidate_is_bloc.AsyncActionLoadPrimaryAsset / AsyncLoadP: PrimaryAsset FStructProperty size 16 = FPrimaryAssetId (2 FNames, not interned) + LoadBundles FArrayProperty (allocator-dependent) + WorldContextObject
why_every_load_capable_candidate_is_bloc.AsyncActionHandleSaveGame:AsyncLoadGameF: SlotName FStrProperty (allocator) and/or FDelegateProperty; also not an asset-by-path loader
why_every_load_capable_candidate_is_bloc.GameplayStatics:CancelAsyncLoading / Pla: ParmsSize 0 -- take no target at all

structural_conclusion: Every reflected entry point that can load an asset by identity requires that identity as either an FString or an FName-bearing type (FName, FTopLevelAssetPath, FSoftObjectPath, FSoftObjectPtr, FPrimaryAssetId). No reflected function accepts a raw package id, chunk id, or any other non-name identity. Since our target's FNames are provably NOT interned (fname-pool-check.json, positive control MirrorTableRow FOUND) and FString construction is allocator-dependent, no such candidate can exist in the reflected surface. This is a property of the reflection API's identity model, not a gap in the search.
consequence: Option C is closed. Supplying the target identity necessarily requires either allocator-backed FString construction or name interning -- both of which are engine calls.
